Tandy Leather reported a sharp turnaround in third-quarter (2026) profitability, per aggregator coverage; specific figures not independently located this session (Q3 2025 a year earlier had shown a $1.4M net loss)

Tandy Leather Factory reported Q3 2026 results (exact date unconfirmed — see conflicts): revenue of $18.5M (+7.3% YoY), net income of $0.5M ($0.06/share) versus a $1.4M net loss a year earlier; gross margin rose to 62.4% from 58.9%; cash was $5.7M as of 2026-09-30
catalysts.impact: Swing to profitability and margin improvement

catalysts.headline: Q3 2026 results (quarter ended 2026-09-30): revenue $18.5M (+7.3% YoY from $17.3M); net income $0.5M vs net loss $1.4M a year earlier; EPS $0.06 vs $(0.17); operating income $0.6M; adjusted EBITDA $0.9M; gross margin 62.4% (up from 58.9%); cash fell to $5.7M from $16.1M at 12/31/25, mainly reflecting a $6.0M dividend paid in Q1 2026 plus inventory/store investment
catalysts.impact: Swing to profitability after a year-ago loss

conflicts: Exact Q3 2026 earnings date is unconfirmed: one estimate puts it at 2026-11-10 after market close; another estimate puts it around 2026-11-16. The primary press release/8-K was not located in sources reviewed, so the Q3 2026 figures reported here come only from third-party aggregator coverage (Panabee/Quiver Quant), not a confirmed primary source.

Cash commentary: one aggregator's analysis states cash fell 65% year-to-date (from $16.1M at 2025 year-end to $5.7M at 2026-09-30), attributing this mainly to a Q1 2026 special dividend and crediting a one-time tariff refund for part of the margin gain — this is the aggregator's own interpretation, not confirmed company language.

No reliable share price/market cap quote newer than 2026-08-26 ($2.60 / $21.3M market cap, MarketChameleon) was found; other undated sources show a $25.41M market cap and prices ranging roughly $2.20-$4.20 across unclear dates.
Dividend history: one source cites a $0.75 special dividend paid around 2026-02-24; another source states flatly that the company does not pay a dividend — these directly conflict.
notes: Could not confirm a current (2026-11-13) stock quote in this research pass; recommend checking a live source (e.g., Nasdaq) directly before publishing a price.
